change_from_exp_023.action: boundary_gated_exact selectively abstains from the G0 exact saved repair candidate
change_from_exp_023.mechanism: when 1 < probe_utility / utility_threshold <= 2, record an explicit boundary_utility_gate abstention; above ratio 2, consume the immutable Phase1 repair candidate exactly. Coordinate candidates are always consumed exactly.
change_from_exp_023.evidence_basis: exp_023 relation_impact_report.json: boundary_repairs mean_credit=-0.01035 (95% CI [-0.0191, -0.0028], relation-cluster bootstrap n=26 clusters, excludes zero); boundary variance_ratio 95% CI [0.0019, 0.2434] (clearly below 1, so boundary is NOT a high-variance zone that sharpening could fix); nonboundary mean_credit=-0.0340 (worse, not better) so raising sharpening near the boundary is not supported by the data either
change_from_exp_023.known_unexplained_finding: The pre-G0 exp_023 association is used only to define this abstention stress test; its final outcomes are not comparable with the repaired 1000-dimensional benchmark.
change_from_exp_023.hypothesis: boundary abstention may reduce harmful exact repair consumption while preserving higher-utility exact actions

controls.interpretation: R4 is the conforming-overlap control; any repair consumption or catastrophic loss is a hard warning

relation_impact_analysis.outcome: immediate normalized objective credit of the writeback; conservative_no_action is exactly zero
relation_impact_analysis.bootstrap_cluster: problem_id + seed + owner-group pair + shared-vars hash

hypotheses.H1: boundary-zone repair candidates abstain without changing selection or spending extra FE
hypotheses.H2: all non-abstained runtime actions write the immutable Phase1 shared values exactly
hypotheses.H4_not_claimed: pre-G0 exp_022/023 final outcomes are not used as post-G0 comparators
